nodes.label: graphify query-first navigation rule
nodes.rationale: graphify query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output, so they run before any grep or source read; raw files are read only for lines already located; the rule is propagated into every code-exploring subagent prompt; wiki/index.md is preferred for broad navigation.

nodes.label: graphify update after code changes
nodes.rationale: Running `graphify update .` after code changes keeps the graph current at no API cost (AST-only). graph.json is rewritten whole on every build, so large PR diffs to it are expected and are not churn.
